target_customer: Engineering teams running several AI coding agents in parallel (Shepherd, free for YC companies in open beta); earlier launch targeted manufacturers
problem: Multiple AI coding agents across sessions and team members cause merge conflicts and duplicated work because they cannot coordinate. An earlier product aimed at manufacturing operations workflows across ERP, CRM and MES systems.
business_model: Open source MCP tool with free beta, hosted option; monetization not stated; manufacturing agents product sold to manufacturers

founders.name: Martin Pan
education: University of Pennsylvania, BS and MS, Mechanical Engineering/Robotics

founders.name: Alex Liu
education: University of Notre Dame, CS and Applied Math

technical_complexity.rationale: Shepherd is an MCP server that relays state between agent sessions, a modest engineering task for three engineers in 2026.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and the pattern is simple to copy, many orchestrators and coordination MCPs already exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet observable. Coding agent vendors were shipping their own multi agent and team features in 2026.

market_need_then: Teams adopted parallel coding agents in 2025 and 2026 and reported conflicts between sessions, per the Shepherd launch post.

identity.logo: Plain wordmark with no stated logo detail
identity.visual_style: Minimal; website is a single name and an access request form

branding.community_and_virality: Team post offered $1,000 in AI credits to three people; no community evidence beyond that

brand_strength.rationale: Little public brand material; a minimal landing page and no press about the brand.

pivots.from: AI agents for manufacturing (ERP, CRM, MES)
pivots.to: Korso Shepherd, agent coordination MCP for developers
pivots.why: Not stated; the YC page lists Shepherd as the latest launch and the manufacturing product as the previous launch.

outcome_analysis: Korso is a Spring 2026 company that has already moved from manufacturing workflow agents to an open source developer tool for coordinating coding agents. There is no outcome yet, no verified funding and no dated competitor evidence, so the main open questions are whether the pivot finds demand and whether coding agent vendors absorb the feature.
notes: VCBacked (single aggregator) lists about $500K pre-seed in May 2026 with Y Combinator; unverified, so not recorded as a round. VCBacked also describes a supplier communication product, which matches the earlier manufacturing positioning. Competitor search returned undated vendor pages only, so the list is empty. Name origin, logo and domain history not found. No outcome news found. Completeness pass: the pre-seed round is recorded from VCBacked alone; it rests on a single database.
